title: ENDF and Allied Militia Claim Recapture of Alamata as Tigray Blackout Enters Fourth Day
detail: On Sep 28, 2026, Ethiopian forces and allied militia claimed to have captured Alamata in southern Tigray, which Tigrayan forces had held since Jan 30. A pro-government militia posted a video of soldiers marching through the town with Ethiopian flags; Reuters could not verify it. A source cited by Al Jazeera Arabic said the army was advancing toward Mekhoni and Maychew. The TPLF describes its actions as a 'defensive war'. Telecom and internet disruptions in Tigray have lasted since Friday, and the cause is unclear.

media.caption: Ethiopia accuses Sudan, Egypt of backing Tigray rebels as fighting rages

confidenceReason: Capture claim comes from pro-government militia video and a single Al Jazeera Arabic source; Reuters could not verify and no independent confirmation exists.
